title: Competing primary CTAs
summary: Replace dual SHOP MEN/SHOP WOMEN CTAs with a single 'Shop All' CTA to reduce friction and let users self-select later.
problem: Two equally prominent CTAs split user intent and delay the path to purchase.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: Shop All; notes: Replace dual CTAs with a single 'Shop All' CTA to reduce friction and let users self-select later in the funnel.
evidence: H1: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' CTAs: 'SHOP MEN', 'SHOP WOMEN' | H1: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' CTAs: 'SHOP MEN' and 'SHOP WOMEN' with no subheadline in the hero section.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 2.0-8.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Vague hero copy
summary: Rewrite hero headline and add subheadline to directly address visitor intent for comfortable, sustainable shoes.
problem: The hero headline and subhead are abstract and feature-led, failing to directly address the visitor's intent to find comfortable, sustainable shoes, which may cause them to bounce without engaging.
recommended_change: h1: Comfortable Shoes, Made from Nature; cta: Shop Best Sellers; notes: Add a subheadline: 'Free shipping & returns. Find your perfect fit in minutes.' This directly addresses the visitor's search for comfortable, sustainable footwear and provides a clear next step.
evidence: H1: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.' CTAs: 'SHOP MEN' and 'SHOP WOMEN' with no subheadline in the hero section.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 2.0-8.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Shipping delay warning
summary: Soften the shipping delay notice and replace with trust-building messaging to reduce objection.
problem: The prominent 'orders may take up to 30 days to ship' notice at the top of the homepage creates immediate hesitation and may deter conversions by signaling fulfillment risk.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.; cta: SHOP MEN / SHOP WOMEN; notes: Soften the messaging to 'Free shipping on orders over $100' and move the delay notice to a less prominent location, or replace with a trust-building line like 'Free 30-day returns' to reduce objection.
evidence: Body sample: 'Due to increased demand, orders may take up to 30 days to ship.'
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 2.0-8.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Free shipping threshold hidden
summary: Include the free shipping threshold in the hero or near CTAs to set clear expectations.
problem: The homepage hero promotes 'Free ground shipping on orders over $100' but the threshold is not visible on the hero or in the main navigation, creating an expectation gap for users who may not see the fine print.
recommended_change: h1: Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural. Free Shipping Over $100; cta: SHOP MEN / SHOP WOMEN; notes: Include the free shipping threshold in the hero or near CTAs to set clear expectations.
evidence: Homepage body_sample: 'Free ground shipping on orders over $100' appears in the top bar, but the hero section (H1: 'Wildly Comfortable. Super Natural.') and CTAs ('SHOP MEN', 'SHOP WOMEN') do not mention the threshold. The threshold is only in the site-wide announcement bar, which may be overlooked.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value

title: Mega-menu choice overload

title: Out-of-stock notification form

problem: The product page for Anytime Ankle Sock shows a 'Get Notified' CTA, indicating the item is out of stock, but the form likely only captures an email without offering alternatives or a clear restock timeline, risking lost sales.

title: Missing review count
summary: Add a review summary (e.g., '4.5 stars (1,200 reviews)') under the price to provide social proof.
problem: The product page lacks a visible review count or rating summary near the price, which is a common trust signal that reduces purchase hesitation for new visitors.
recommended_change: h1: Anytime Ankle Sock; cta: Add to Cart; notes: Add a review summary (e.g., '4.5 stars (1,200 reviews)') directly under the price to provide social proof and reduce hesitation.
evidence: The page has a section 'Reviews for Anytime Ankle Sock' but no review count or star rating is visible in the provided inventory; the trust flags show 'reviews: true' but the count is not surfaced.

title: Single-field email capture

title: Controls without accessible names
summary: Give every control a visible text label or aria-label to meet WCAG 2.2 AA.
problem: 41 of 79 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
recommended_change: notes: Give every control a visible text label or an aria-label. WCAG 2.2 AA, success criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 of 79 <button> elements contain no text content and no aria-label.
opportunity_basis: 2,160,000 annual visits x 2.10% conversion x 1.0-5.0% relative lift x $78 order value
